steps.text: The massive machine sits silent in the darkness.
The intertwining tubes are like sprawling rhizomes, shoots growing out at the ends.
Each shoot is an electrode glowing faintly, absorbing nutrition from the lifeform underneath.
The missing Pioneers lie side by side, electrodes on their heads.
They breathe and their hearts beat, but they are oblivious to what is happening around them.
A silvery liquid flows through the tubes, converging on the device at the center of the room.
It seems more alive than the dozens of catatonic test subjects.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: How could this be...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Helen?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Why...?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dirk! Gale! Sophia!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: They're all here...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Let them go.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Please, keep your voice down. Don't startle them.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Wait here a while, my friends... everything will be alright, once I take care of this little problem. I promise.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Are you talking to them? I doubt they can hear you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've never seen symptoms like these... except on the unconscious Joyce.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The electrodes and the silver liquid... they're connected to their central nervous systems, aren't they?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy... why is Helen here?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: She was worried that she would fail Ferdinand's test. I made a suggestion.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: A suggestion... to become a test subject?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Helen was chatting with us just this morning. Now she lies here as conscious as a plank of wood.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I want to help her, Elena.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I can feel her pain... just like I feel all of theirs.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Helen's debts are weighing an entire family down.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: She lives in constant fear... she would take her own life if Ferdinand fired her.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: To stop now would be to deliver them into the hands of merciless fate.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I can't do something so cruel.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Stop with the self-righteousness already, or I can't promise I'll keep my finger off the trigger.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Your hatred of me stems from your lack of understanding of what you see, and of me.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But I understand you.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Like hell you do!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You understand us so well you'll oh so benevolently give us a chance at a new life. Instead of dying in a Catastrophe or getting eaten by monsters...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We get to be technically-alive half-corpses in the lab of a big corporation!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Where do I line up to kiss your feet?!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Have you never thought about it, Sonny? Why is it that some people with Oripathy can keep working, while others are forced to leave their homes?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't need you to tell me.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The day after I got diagnosed, I found my insurance contract and pink slip waiting for me.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The contract was five hundred and sixty-nine pages. The sheet telling me I was fired didn't fill half the paper.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: There aren't a lot of companies out there willing to hire an Infected. We gotta prove we're worth that outrageous insurance premium.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Don't you think it's unfair?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Kinda goes without saying, doesn't it?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Then you should understand.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I can't reach Silence or Greyy.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The site must be entirely closed off.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Fer...dinand...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Closing off the lab is just the means, not the end.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Ferdinand is planning something at Site 359.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, Silence and the others are in danger.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: We're not getting anything from the site... should we move to assist?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: True... data transmission from Device #9 is different from standard communication. We only need a moment's signal to see what Ptilopsis is seeing.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I'll try to sync up with her.
Are you sure you want to meet with him alone, Miss Franks?
Yes, I have permission from the bureau.
They say that man, Loken Williams, is a complete nutjob. He got a hundred years in prison for his cruel human experimentation.
I know. I've sat in his lectures before.
These scientists are out of their minds... oh, sorry, I forgot you were a scientist too. But you're such a gentle and elegant lady. Surely you're not like them!
I understand. Thank you for being concerned about my safety. I'll be careful.
How long do you expect you'll be in there?
An hour. I can come back again same time next week, if necessary.
You want to talk to him that badly? He doesn't usually care about other people...
Maybe it's because of all the things people ask him for, I'm the only one asking for help.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Everyone deserves a chance, we should all have equal access to opportunity. Differences in talent should not determine one's destiny.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: When someone with talent becomes privileged because of that talent, they are infringing on someone else's interests, undermining fairness.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm among the privileged. And I'm ashamed of my 'luck.'

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I wanted to pull you out of the bog before it swallowed you—Dirk, Helen, and you, Sonny.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I have done all this in the hopes that one day, fortune will smile only upon those who work hard, rather than favor the so-called 'talented'.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I've spent many years working towards this goal.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Altering the individual to make it stronger does not solve the problem.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Those who were born strong can be even stronger with the same alterations, widening the gap even further.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: In order to achieve true equality, I must...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You wanted to eliminate individual differences?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The unconscious test subjects... Originium Arts constructs with emotional responses... a massive machine that links them together...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Your experiments... they're...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've heard of something like them before, but I thought it was just a mad dream, one that failed a long time ago.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Mad dream?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: There's no such thing as 'mad' science. It's just a means to an end.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: We can't ignore or forget the innate differences between individuals, but that doesn't mean we have to be burdened by them forever.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: My technology will allow people to stand before each other as equals, sharing equally the soil, the air, and the rain.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No longer will their footsteps be stopped by mountains, nor their sight be obstructed by storms.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They will look into the distance from a place of safety, without having to endure the toil of long journeys and separation from their loved ones.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Don't you understand the beauty of such a future?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did I never actually understand...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What exactly were we doing here?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We've been looking for the caster behind the silver constructs.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We thought it was the individual Pioneers, but we were wrong.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The caster was all of them.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You have sharp eyes, Dr. Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Franks, the future you imagine is just that... your imagination.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I see something different.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: A skilled Originium Arts caster can destroy a building. Three skilled casters can suppress an entire city block.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What would happen if you joined the power of ten people, a hundred people, a thousand people?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Nothing under the sun will escape its gaze. The strongest fortress will be little more than a toy that it could crush with a thought.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: As for the people you care about, the ones you call friends... they will never be more than test subjects in the eyes of those who want to harness the technology.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Those who fail will be the lucky ones. They'll be ignored, allowed to live and die on their own.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: A worse fate befalls those who succeed.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The day their experiment succeeds, they'll be doomed to live under the watchful eyes of corporations and governments.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia... I've never seen you like this...
This angry.
Silence can feel her own anger, like a humming in her mind. Scenes from the past flash across her eyes, as she feels her reason and calm disintegrate.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You may have changed their destiny, but at what price? They'll lose their freedom forever, their lives no longer their own.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: ...I'll protect them.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If it costs my very life.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Killing you, right here, right now just might be best for everyone.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If that's your consensus...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Then I won't resist.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Don't lose your head, Sonny!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Lose my head, Doc?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm calmer than I've ever been.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dorothy Franks... I gotta admit, the picture of the future you're painting has some appeal.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Same as how I almost walked into your lab... you don't know how many times I thought about taking your hand.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Why didn't you?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Because my future... belongs to me.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The things you say, not to mention the look of you there... the more welcoming the whole deal, the clearer I see it...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You're controlling us.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: It's harder to break out of a sweet dream than a nightmare.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Maybe you're living that dream, Director Franks, but the rest of us are here facing reality.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Silence was right. An experiment like this should never have existed to begin with.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The lands across our world have given birth to enough madness. This kinda madness oughta get buried deep, and never dug up again.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Whatever it costs.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We gotta put a stop to this.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia! Make Sonny listen!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whatever came of it... Dorothy was only trying to help these people.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Even if I thought she needed to be stopped, to be punished, it shouldn't end like this... not by the ones she truly loved...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Sonny...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Joyce?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You... you're awake?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Don't hurt Director Franks.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Synchronization failed.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The situation at Site 359 may be worse than we thought.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Thank you for the help, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I can feel my legs now.

options: Site 359 is about more than just Rhine Lab.
Ferdinand is working with more powerful forces.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You know who Ferdinand is working with, don't you, Saria?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The power armor you've been tracking just might end up in the hands of those who most need cutting-edge weaponry.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You've seen them. Evidence?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You'll have it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That warmth I felt back there, that was a little wishful thinky on my part, huh? I put my life on the line to get the evidence you wanted.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Our hypothesis was right.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Ferdinand is no longer hiding his ambition.

options: He's leveraging this experiment to garner support...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...and he'll use it to seize control of Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We have to find Kristen. She is Ferdinand's prime target.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Did you get my last message, Saria?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: My contacts inside Rhine say everything is normal.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's because they're used to Control's absence.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ferdinand's been planning this for years, undermining Control's authority, little by little... this experiment is the last step.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Or maybe not the last one...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I hadn't been in contact with Kristen for a week before they got me.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: What about the site?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I wouldn't be too worried about Dr. Silence. I still remember that time she got the upper hand of me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: This is no time for indecision, Saria.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You have to make a choice.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: This is no multiple choice question, Doctor.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The key to resolving the situation at the site is Ferdinand, and the key to taking care of Ferdinand lies before us.

options: Let's go see the Control of Rhine.
